stories.headline: Tim Curry, actor known for "The Rocky Horror Picture Show" and "It," dies at age 80 - CBS News
stories.summary: Tim Curry was known for his iconic performances in cult classics like "The Rocky Horror Picture Show" and the original screen adaptation of Stephen King's "It."

stories.headline: Dolly Parton died after a brief period of cancer - The Washington Post
stories.summary: The singer, songwriter, actress and philanthropist was admitted to the Vanderbilt-Ingram Cancer Center in Nashville last week.

stories.headline: Rick Steves purchased a century-old movie theater. Here are his plans for it - The Seattle Times
stories.summary: Travel writer Rick Steves, a lifelong Edmonds local who has long imagined owning The Edmonds Theater, bought the historic moviehouse for a little over $2 million.

stories.headline: Prince Harry and Meghan arrive back in U.K., BBC News reports - CBS News
stories.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan, the Duke and Duchess of Sussex, returned to the U.K. from California on Wednesday, six years after their tumultuous departure, the BBC reports.

stories.summary: Bravo continues to give out diamonds, and Leah Remini is the latest to get one, as she is set to join The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills.

stories.headline: Lil Durk Trial: Jurors See Unreleased ‘Redman’ Video, Defense Calls It ‘Expression of Art’ - Rolling Stone
stories.summary: Lil Durk’s murder-for-hire trial jurors saw his unreleased 'Redman' video as prosecutors suggested it proved motive and the defense said it was 'art.'

stories.headline: Michelle Obama Stuns in a Low-Cut Green Striped Halterneck Dress During Martha’s Vineyard Outing - instyle.com
stories.summary: Michelle Obama looked radiant in a vivid green-and-white striped halterneck dress with a ruched bodice while stepping out in Martha’s Vineyard in photos shared on August 26.
